scope: Original tests plus matched-background tests; synthetic data only, no user biological dataset supplied
bulk_scope: Paired or independent biological units; no general covariate regression; no user biological dataset supplied
synthetic_demo: 8 paired donors, 800 genes, 50 target genes, 99 controls; 256 exact paired label swaps; artificially strong effect

counts_input: nonnegative integer-valued counts; positive library sizes
